name: RACING DEMON
description: Racing Demon is a patience card game that involves tableau, foundations, stock. The game originated in Europe and has become popular worldwide.

content.text: Racing Demon is a patience card game that involves tableau, foundations, stock. The game originated in Europe and has become popular worldwide.

Country/Region of Origin: Europe
Time Period: Early 1900s
Historical Development: The game evolved from traditional card games in the region
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Standard 52-card deck
Score sheet (optional)
Table space

Cards per Player: Varies by player count
Dealing Pattern: Clockwise
--

items.text: Jokers: Two jokers per deck; joker stands for any card. When playing a joker onto a foundation the player must announce rank and suit before moving it. On work piles no announcement needed.
Nerts pile size: Some play with 12 cards (11 face down, one up) or 11 cards (10 face down, one up) in the Nerts pile instead of 13.
